tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Maximal trees exist] ↗ def:subgraph-and-tree 1. ch1:1A.1\group Fundamental Group

Every connected graph contains a maximal tree, and every tree extends to one.

Proof

\sketch Starting from a tree, successively attach edges needed to reach every new vertex, choosing one edge per new vertex. The resulting increasing union contains all vertices and deformation retracts stage by stage to the original tree, hence remains a tree.

□
